note: Why a column shows rock (the crust's bare-stone setting, riven-surface.json); the blocks every setting lays are in riven-surface.json. Certified rocky formations expose vanilla stone and resolve actual solid/void occupancy before fluids and cover. Their admission excludes supplied water and bank/inlet skirts. Authorized sediment replaces deposited volume and surface soil with sand. Earlier marine ownership and water heads remain unchanged; final authorized emergence is separate. Other exposed-stone rules retain precedence over dryland cover; deep general surface, yardang, cold-region and volcanic cuts expose stone. Earlier supplied water and wetland cover keep priority. Geometry supplies no ice, lava, new water, heat or reconstructed geological materials. Soil before rock (v90): a rocky shore shows rock only within splashBlocks of the water (plus capeSplashBlocks at full cape exposure) and on cliff faces within cliffFaceBlocks; inland of that it takes the ordinary cover. High ground shows rock above a treeline: the stone line (stoneAboveReference) at referenceCelsius, moved blocksPerDegree per degree of the column's temperature, at most lowestBelowStoneBlocks lower and highestAboveStoneBlocks higher; mountain landforms show rock only within mountainBelowTreelineBlocks of it. A cut shows rock when deeper than exposedCutDepthBlocks where nothing grows back, rising to growingCutBlocks where plants return: as moisture climbs moistureSpan past an aridity threshold (aridMoisture, plus aridMoisturePerDegreeAbove10 per degree above 10 C) and temperature through celsiusRange.
